# Coverage

<!-- Generated by `composer coverage:md` from coverage/manifest.php and the installed libraries. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every `@api` symbol of `middag-io/framework` and `middag-io/ui`, with the demo artifact that exercises it and the test that proves it.
Generated from `middag-io/framework` v1.22.0 and `middag-io/ui` v1.13.0, as installed from `composer.lock`.

- **covered**: the demo uses the symbol, or reaches it through another one; the tests and E2E specs listed prove it.
- **host**: a contract a host adapter implements. The moodle and wordpress adapters prove it in their own suites.
- **gap**: not proved by the demo, with the reason. A test may still prove that the symbol is emitted when no free renderer consumes it.

`ApiCoverageTest` keeps this map in step with the installed libraries: it fails when an `@api` symbol is missing from the map, when the map names a symbol, a test method or an E2E title that does not exist, or when an entry lacks its proof or its reason.

## UI wire surface

Block, cell, field, layout and shell types the PHP contract emits and the free React renderer draws. `CoverageManifestTest` boots each route and asserts the type is emitted, that no PRO block leaks and that no catalogued gap is emitted silently.

| Symbol | Proof route | Note |
|---|---|---|
| `shell:basic` | `/` | login + every help-desk page |
| `shell:immersive` | `/help` | help + coverage pages |
| `layout:dashboard` | `/` | metrics + chart grid |
| `layout:sidebar` | `/tickets/{id}` | ticket detail — main + aside metric cards |
| `layout:stack` | `/customers` | default single column |
| `layout:wizard` | `/tickets/new` | guided two-step ticket create — server-driven stepping, partial in session |
| `block:metric_card` | `/` | queue metrics |
| `block:status_strip` | `/` | SLA health + score ring; ticket status lifecycle on /tickets/{id} |
| `block:dense_table` | `/tickets` | the cell showcase |
| `block:chart` | `/` | tickets created per day (free ChartBlock) |
| `block:detail_panel` | `/agents/{id}` | agent fields |
| `block:link_list` | `/agents/{id}` | assigned tickets |
| `block:card_grid` | `/customers` | customer cards |
| `block:markdown_panel` | `/help` | walkthrough |
| `block:empty_state` | `/help` | first-use nudge |
| `block:action_grid` | `/help` | quick links |
| `block:form_panel` | `/tickets/new` | framework form pipeline |
| `block:tabs` | `/tickets/{id}` | details, activity and SLA tabs |
| `block:activity_timeline` | `/tickets/{id}` | comment feed, nested in the tabs block |
| `cell:status` | `/tickets` | ticket status |
| `cell:rich_status` | `/tickets` | priority {label,appearance,icon} |
| `cell:annotated` | `/tickets` | assignee {text,sublabel} |
| `cell:tag_chips` | `/tickets` | custom registerCellRenderer — ticket tags as labelled pill links |
| `cell:timestamp` | `/tickets` | created date |
| `cell:boolean` | `/parity` | parity match flag |
| `cell:progress` | `/agents` | agent workload (supervisor view) |
| `cell:link` | `/agents/{id}` | agent email as a mailto link, href interpolates {email} (supervisor view) |
| `cell:html` | `/agents` | availability badge — server-controlled HTML, role escaped (supervisor view) |
| `cell:sparkline` | `/agents/{id}` | custom registerCellRenderer (the chart-block seam, cell edition) — 7-day intake (supervisor view) |
| `field:text` | `/tickets/new` | subject, tags |
| `field:textarea` | `/tickets/new` | description |
| `field:select` | `/tickets/new` | channel, priority, SLA |
| `field:entity_picker` | `/tickets/new` | customer + assignee (live source) |
| `field:date` | `/tickets/new` | due date |
| `engine:message_bus` | — | sync command dispatch (create/update/transition/comment) |
| `engine:async_signal` | — | demo.ticket.created -> EscalateSlaCommand on the async transport |
| `engine:dual_orm_parity` | `/parity` | data-mapper QueryBuilder vs active-record ModelQuery, identical counts |
| `engine:persistent_bus` | — | Doctrine transport: a command queued by one runtime kernel is drained by another on the same database (RuntimeKernelTest) |
| `engine:entity_source` | `/tickets/new` | EntitySourceRegistry: demo_customers + demo_agents |
| `engine:capability_gate` | `/agents` | helpdesk:supervise gates the supervisor columns |
| `engine:register_host` | `/login` | host registerShell("auth") replaces the package auth shell; host registerCellRenderer("sparkline") and ("tag_chips") add cells |
| `condition:required_when_in` | `/tickets/new` | assignee required_when priority IN [high,urgent] |

| Gap | Reason |
|---|---|
| `block:pro` | PRO blocks (chart_panel, workflow_progress, kanban_board, flow_editor, form_builder, condition_tree, sentence_builder) + the product shell ship in @middag-io/react-pro, out of the free OSS surface |
| `cell:link_group` | the free link_group cell renders icon-only ghost-button links (the label is only a tooltip), not readable text chips; the help-desk domain has no natural icon-link-group column, and ticket tags read far better as the custom tag_chips cell |
| `field:duration` | emittable via FieldDefinition::duration() but no free React field renderer (would hit "Unknown field component") |
| `field:otp_slider_native_select_tags` | React-renderable but no FieldDefinition factory method |
| `field:currency_rating_slug_color_phone_document` | React-renderable but absent from the PHP FieldType enum entirely |

## Internal classes the demo still names

Classes the libraries mark `@internal`. The demo names them only where no `@api` seam covers the need.

None: every library class the demo names is `@api`.

## Out of scope

The Moodle and WordPress adapters, the transactional outbox, multi-tenancy, organisation scope, licensing, host enforcement of `#[Auth]` and the PRO blocks are not part of the OSS surface the demo proves. The adapters keep their own coverage in their repositories.
